records.jp: ……あっ！　きらら、あそこ！
records.en_original: Oh, Kirara, over there!
records.en: ...Ah! Kirara, over there!

records.jp: 記憶のかけら……
records.en_original: A fragment of memory...
records.en: A memory shard...

records.jp: 声が聞こえる？
records.en_original: You can hear a voice?
records.en: You can hear a voice?

records.jp: うん。それを言ったら、周りに怖がられて……。<CR>きららは一人になった
records.en_original: Yes. But when I said that, everyone became afraid of me... That's why I'm alone.
records.en: Yes. When Kirara said so, everyone became afraid...<CR>and Kirara was left alone.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: Oh...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: 怖くないのか？
records.en_original: You're not afraid?
records.en: Are you not afraid?

records.jp: うん……だってこうして話してても、きららちゃんは<CR>普通の子だもん。気にしないよ
records.en_original: Nope. Talking with you, you seem like a normal girl to me.
records.en: No... Because even while we talk like this, Kirara-chan<CR>is an ordinary girl. It does not bother me.

records.jp: ユカ……
records.en_original: Yuka...
records.en: Yuka...

records.jp: ユカ、その、よかったら……きららと遊ぼう
records.en_original: Would you like to, um, hang out?
records.en: Yuka, um, if you would like... play with Kirara.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: で、でも、私と遊んでもつまらないよ？<CR>みんなそういうもん。トロイからって
records.en_original: B-but I'm no fun to be around. At least, that's what everyone says...
records.en: B-but playing with me will be boring.<CR>Everyone says so. They say I am slow.

records.jp: きららも気にしない。<CR>ユカが気にしないと言ってくれたから
records.en_original: I don't care about that. You did the same thing for me.
records.en: Kirara does not mind either.<CR>Because Yuka said she did not mind.

records.jp: それに、こうしてちゃんと話を聞いてくれるの……<CR>すごく楽しい
records.en_original: And talking with you like this...it's fun.
records.en: Besides, having someone listen properly like this...<CR>is very enjoyable.

records.jp: きららちゃん……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en: Kirara-chan...

records.jp: ……思い出した。<CR>神の声を頼ったわけではなかった……
records.en_original: I remember... I never relied on the Divine...
records.en: ...Kirara remembers.<CR>Kirara did not rely on the Divine's voice...

records.jp: それから、毎日のようにユカと遊んで……
records.en_original: After that I saw Yuka almost every day.
records.en: After that, Kirara played with Yuka almost every day...

records.jp: でも、分からない。どうしてユカは<CR>きららと一緒にいてくれたんだろう？
records.en_original: I don't understand. Why did Yuka spend time with me like that?
records.en: But Kirara does not understand. Why did Yuka<CR>keep staying with Kirara?

records.jp: やっぱり、きららは神の声が聞こえるから……？
records.en_original: Was it really because I could hear the Divine?
records.en: Was it because Kirara could hear the Divine's voice after all...?

records.jp: んー……<CR>私は、なんとなく分かるけどなあ
records.en_original: Mmm... I think I get it.
records.en: Hmm...<CR>I feel like I understand.

records.jp: ユカちゃんは、きららと一緒にいると<CR>ありのままの自分でいられたんじゃない？
records.en_original: Yuka felt like she could be herself when she was with you.
records.en: When Yuka-chan was with you,<CR>perhaps she could be her unguarded self?

records.jp: 周りの目を気にして、自分らしくいられる<CR>場所がなかったのかも。……きららの前以外は
records.en_original: Everyone else judged her so harshly. But with you she didn't have to worry about that.
records.en: Perhaps she worried about how others saw her and had no place<CR>where she could be herself... except in front of you, Kirara.

records.jp: そういう意味では、きららはユカちゃんにとって<CR>「特別な友達」だったのかもね
records.en_original: I think you were really special to her.
records.en: In that sense, perhaps you were<CR>a "special friend" to Yuka-chan, Kirara.

records.jp: 「特別な友達」……
records.en_original: Special to her...
records.en: A "special friend"...

records.jp: 思い出してみなよ。ユカちゃんって、<CR>きららを利用しようとしたことあった？
records.en_original: Try and think back. Did she ever try to take advantage of your power?
records.en: Think back. Did Yuka-chan ever<CR>try to use you, Kirara?

records.jp: でしょ。それは、二人にとって大切なのが<CR>きららと一緒にいることだったからだよ
records.en_original: Exactly. The important thing to her was spending time with you.
records.en: Exactly. Because what mattered to the two of you<CR>was being together.

records.jp: 信じよう。<CR>きららが大好きなユカちゃんのことを
records.en_original: Yuka cared about you. Believe that.
records.en: Believe in her.<CR>Believe in Yuka-chan, whom Kirara loves.

records.jp: そして何より、ユカちゃんを信じた自分自身のことを
records.en_original: And if you can believe that, you can believe in yourself.
records.en: And above all, believe in yourself, who believed in Yuka-chan.

records.jp: ……自惚れても、いいのだろうか
records.en_original: ...I wonder if it's okay for me to be selfish.
records.en: ...Is it all right for Kirara to be so conceited?

records.jp: きららは、神の声がなくても<CR>誰かから、必要としてもらえるって
records.en_original: To want to be needed by someone even without my powers.
records.en: To believe that even without the Divine's voice,<CR>someone can need Kirara.

records.jp: うん。<CR>私には、きららが必要だよ
records.en_original: I think it's more than okay. I need you, Kirara.
records.en: Yes.<CR>I need you, Kirara.

records.jp: 受け入れて、いいのだろうか。<CR>今のきららも、きららなんだって……
records.en_original: Is it okay for me to accept myself as I am now?
records.en: Is it all right to accept<CR>that the Kirara of now is also Kirara...?

records.jp: うん。どんなきららでも、<CR>私にとっては、大切な友達だよ
records.en_original: It is. No matter what, you're my friend.
records.en: Yes. No matter what kind of Kirara you are,<CR>you are a precious friend to me.

records.jp: そうか……<CR>そうなのか……
records.en_original: I... I see...
records.en: I see...<CR>So that is how it is...

records.jp: ……違う
records.en_original: No.

records.jp: 本当は、自分でもわかってるはずだ
records.en_original: You should understand.
records.en: Deep down, you should understand it yourself.

records.jp: 力を失ったきららは、誰にも必要とされない。<CR>生きている価値さえないのだと
records.en_original: You are useless without your power. You don't even deserve to live.
records.en: A Kirara who has lost her power is needed by no one.<CR>She is not even worth living.

records.jp: きららも、そう思ってたのだ。<CR>神の声が聞こえないきららは、役立たずだと
records.en_original: I used to think so too. That I was nothing without the Divine.
records.en: Kirara thought so too.<CR>That a Kirara who could not hear the Divine's voice was useless.

records.jp: だけど……
records.en_original: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: もう、違うよ
records.en_original: That's not true anymore.
records.en: That is no longer true.

records.jp: 神の声が聞こえなくても<CR>きららは、きららでいいの
records.en_original: Even if I can't hear the Divine anymore, I'm still Kirara!
records.en: Even if Kirara cannot hear the Divine's voice,<CR>Kirara is allowed to be Kirara.

records.jp: それでいいって、言ってくれる人がいるから。<CR>必要としてくれる人がいるから
records.en_original: And I have people who accept me for the way I am.
records.en: Because there are people who tell Kirara that is enough.<CR>Because there are people who need Kirara.

records.jp: 私は、ここで生きていくよ
records.en_original: So I'm gonna keep on living here!
records.en: I will live here.

records.jp: ふうー……これで一件落着なのだ
records.en_original: Phew... I suppose that settles that.
records.en: Phew... This resolves the matter.

records.jp: あ、いつものきららだ
records.en_original: Oh, you're talking like normal again.
records.en: Ah, the usual Kirara is back.

records.jp: む？　きららは、いつもきららだぞ
records.en_original: Hmph, I am sure I have no idea what you are talking about.
records.en: Hm? Kirara is always Kirara.

records.jp: さっきの喋り方、可愛かったから残念
records.en_original: Aww. It was kinda cute how you were talking before.
records.en: That is too bad. The way you spoke a moment ago was cute.

records.jp: あれは……つい、出てしまった
records.en_original: That was...unintended.
records.en: That was... something that slipped out.

records.jp: また見せてよ
records.en_original: I hope I get to see that side of you sometimes.
records.en: Show me that side again sometime.

records.jp: ……愛央にだけ、たまになら<CR>見せてやらないこともない
records.en_original: If it's you...I suppose I don't mind.
records.en: ...If it is only for Ao, then occasionally,<CR>Kirara may not refuse to show it.

records.jp: それって……私が特別ってこと？
records.en_original: Does that mean I'm special?
records.en: Does that mean... I am special?

records.jp: そうだな。<CR>愛央はきららの……特別な親友だ
records.en_original: Yes. You are...very special to me.
records.en: That is correct.<CR>Ao is Kirara's... special best friend.

records.jp: あはは。そっか
records.en_original: Ahaha, is that so?
records.en: Ahaha. I see.

records.jp: 嬉しい？
records.en_original: Does that make you happy?
records.en: Are you happy?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ふふっ……そうか、良かった
records.en_original: Heh... I'm glad.
records.en: Hehe... I see. Good.

records.jp: それじゃあ、そろそろ帰ろっか
records.en_original: I guess we should head back, huh?
records.en: Then shall we head back soon?

records.jp: ……愛央、向こうに着くまで<CR>手を繋いでいてもいい？
records.en_original: Ao, could we hold hands until we get there?
records.en: ...Ao, may Kirara hold your hand<CR>until we get back?

records.jp: うん、もちろん。<CR>向こうについても、手を繋いでいるよ
records.en_original: Of course. I'll hold your hand as long as you want me to.
records.en: Yeah, of course.<CR>Even after we get back, I will keep holding your hand.
